email_provider.label: Email delivery
email_provider.summary: Transactional email delivery is live through the configured Ferocity sender.
email_provider.fallback: Draft and copy the message for manual sending.

resend_shared.label: Ferocity-managed email
resend_shared.summary: Ferocity-managed outbound email is live. Mailbox ingestion is a separate capability.
resend_shared.fallback: Draft and copy the message for manual sending.

gmail_mailbox.label: Gmail inbox monitoring
gmail_mailbox.summary: Read-only Gmail OAuth and normalized inbox sync are implemented; each customer must connect their own account and production OAuth approval may still be required.
gmail_mailbox.fallback: Forward important mail to the business inbox and handle it manually.

microsoft_mailbox.label: Microsoft 365 inbox monitoring
microsoft_mailbox.summary: Read-only Microsoft Graph mailbox OAuth and normalized inbox sync are implemented; each customer must connect their own account and tenant consent may still be required.
microsoft_mailbox.fallback: Open the message in Outlook and handle it manually.

twilio.label: Customer-owned Twilio
twilio.summary: The adapter exists; each customer must connect valid credentials and complete applicable messaging compliance before live use.
twilio.fallback: Use the native SMS handoff or copy-message flow.

twilio_shared.label: Ferocity-managed texting
twilio_shared.summary: Managed texting remains unavailable while the provider account and required compliance approvals are unresolved.
twilio_shared.fallback: Use customer-owned Twilio, native SMS handoff, email, or copy-message flow.

vonage_sms.label: Vonage managed texting
vonage_sms.summary: Vonage has unblocked the Ferocity account and the provider-independent SMS adapter is implemented. Live use still requires credentials, a sending number, signed webhooks, applicable US messaging registration, funding, and controlled certification.
vonage_sms.fallback: Use Ferocity Connect, a customer-owned provider, email, or manual sending until Vonage certification is complete.

voice_ai.label: Voice AI
voice_ai.summary: Retell outbound calling has been certified; inbound routing, owner briefings, and every alternate engine require separate certification.
voice_ai.fallback: Create a human-call task or use the customer's connected phone provider.

stripe.label: Ferocity subscriptions
stripe.summary: Ferocity subscription checkout and billing are live.

stripe_connect.label: Customer invoice payments
stripe_connect.summary: Online invoice payment works after the customer completes Stripe Connect onboarding.
stripe_connect.fallback: Record an offline payment or send payment instructions.

premium_video_rendering.label: AI video generation
premium_video_rendering.summary: Veo generation is live behind budget and authority controls.
premium_video_rendering.fallback: Create a production brief for external rendering.

public_web_chat.label: Website chat
public_web_chat.summary: The native public chat, live-AI recovery, lead capture, and signup handoff pass local behavioral certification; the current release still needs production certification.
public_web_chat.fallback: If live AI is unavailable, disclose the outage honestly and preserve the lead/contact path without pretending a scripted response is AI.

google_calendar.label: Google Calendar
google_calendar.summary: OAuth and calendar operations are available after a customer connects and authorizes an account.
google_calendar.fallback: Use Ferocity scheduling and iCalendar export.

microsoft_calendar.label: Microsoft Outlook Calendar
microsoft_calendar.summary: OAuth and calendar operations are available after a customer connects and authorizes an account.
microsoft_calendar.fallback: Use Ferocity scheduling and iCalendar export.

google_business_profile.label: Google Business Profile
google_business_profile.summary: Connection and read foundations exist; publishing, reply, and review actions are not all certified live.
google_business_profile.fallback: Prepare drafts and deep-link the user to Google Business Profile.

search_console.label: Google Search Console
search_console.summary: Tenant OAuth, property selection, and read-only 28-day reporting sync are implemented; production connection certification remains per account.
search_console.fallback: Use a website audit and manually supplied search data.

analytics.label: Google Analytics
analytics.summary: Tenant OAuth, GA4 property selection, and read-only 28-day reporting sync are implemented; production connection certification remains per account.
analytics.fallback: Use Ferocity-native attribution and manually imported reports.

nws_weather.label: National Weather Service alerts
nws_weather.summary: Active-alert monitoring and internal lead corroboration are implemented; production service-area certification remains required.
nws_weather.fallback: Use internal lead, capacity, schedule, and proof signals without making a weather-based demand claim.

google_ads.label: Google Ads
google_ads.summary: Customer OAuth authorization is available. Ad-account selection, reporting certification, and live campaign execution remain separately gated.
google_ads.fallback: Prepare an approved campaign package for launch in Google Ads.

youtube.label: YouTube Channel
youtube.summary: Customer OAuth authorization and channel verification are available in read-only mode. Uploading and publishing remain separately permissioned and approval-gated.
youtube.fallback: Prepare the approved video, title, description, thumbnail, and publishing package for manual upload.

facebook.label: Meta and Facebook
facebook.summary: Customer Business Login authorization is available. Page and ad-account selection, reporting certification, publishing, and ad execution remain separately gated.
facebook.fallback: Prepare posts and campaign packages for manual publishing.

tiktok.label: TikTok Login
tiktok.summary: Login Kit authorizes identity and basic profile only. It is deliberately separate from content publishing and advertising.
tiktok.fallback: Use the separate Content Posting or API for Business connection for live actions.

tiktok_content.label: TikTok Content Publishing
tiktok_content.summary: The Direct Post and draft-upload adapters are implemented. TikTok product approval, creator authorization, audit, and controlled certification are still required.
tiktok_content.fallback: Export the approved content package and publish manually in TikTok.

tiktok_business.label: TikTok Ads
tiktok_business.summary: The API for Business OAuth, advertiser discovery, campaign read, reporting, and campaign-create adapter are implemented. App approval and controlled live certification remain required.
tiktok_business.fallback: Prepare the approved campaign package and complete launch in TikTok Ads Manager.

reddit.label: Reddit Ads
reddit.summary: Customer OAuth identity and read authorization are available. Ad-account discovery, reporting certification, publishing, and spend remain separately gated.
reddit.fallback: Prepare a campaign package for Reddit Ads Manager.

microsoft_ads.label: Microsoft Advertising
microsoft_ads.summary: Customer Microsoft Advertising OAuth authorization is available. Account selection, reporting certification, campaign changes, and spend remain separately gated.
microsoft_ads.fallback: Prepare a campaign package for Microsoft Advertising.

linkedin_ads.label: LinkedIn Ads
linkedin_ads.summary: Ferocity models LinkedIn Ads honestly, but live management requires separate LinkedIn Marketing API product approval and customer authorization.
linkedin_ads.fallback: Prepare an approved campaign package for LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

x_ads.label: X Ads
x_ads.summary: Ferocity models X Ads honestly, but live management requires approved Ads API access and advertiser authorization.
x_ads.fallback: Prepare an approved campaign package for X Ads Manager.

pinterest_ads.label: Pinterest Ads
pinterest_ads.summary: Ferocity has a provider-neutral adapter contract, but account connection is not exposed until Ferocity owns an approved Pinterest developer app.
pinterest_ads.fallback: Prepare an approved campaign package for Pinterest Ads Manager.

snapchat_ads.label: Snap Ads
snapchat_ads.summary: Ferocity has a provider-neutral adapter contract, but account connection is not exposed until Ferocity owns an approved Snap organization and OAuth app.
snapchat_ads.fallback: Prepare an approved campaign package for Snapchat Ads Manager.

amazon_ads.label: Amazon Ads
amazon_ads.summary: Ferocity has a provider-neutral adapter contract, but account connection is not exposed until Ferocity receives eligible Amazon Ads developer access.
amazon_ads.fallback: Prepare an approved campaign package for Amazon Ads.

openai_ads.label: ChatGPT Ads
openai_ads.summary: Ferocity has a provider-neutral adapter contract, but no ordinary customer OAuth flow is exposed. Eligible advertiser or partner access and server-side credentials are still required.
openai_ads.fallback: Prepare an approved campaign package for the OpenAI Ads account.

apple_search_ads.label: Apple Ads
apple_search_ads.summary: Ferocity has a provider-neutral adapter contract for eligible App Store and Apple Maps advertisers, but onboarding requires an account role/invite and Ferocity-managed OAuth key material rather than a normal customer OAuth button.
apple_search_ads.fallback: Prepare an approved campaign package for Apple Ads.

jobber.label: Jobber
jobber.summary: OAuth and read-only synchronization have been certified; write-back remains off until separately certified.
jobber.fallback: Use Ferocity independently or import/export records.

highlevel.label: HighLevel
highlevel.summary: A customer-owned location token can write concise Ferocity call notes to mapped contacts; broader coexistence uses the signed bridge.
highlevel.fallback: Use Ferocity independently or configure the signed service-platform bridge.

housecall_pro.label: Housecall Pro
housecall_pro.summary: The signed coexistence bridge is available; native multi-customer write access remains partner-gated.
housecall_pro.fallback: Use Ferocity independently or send the concise call event through approved middleware.

hubspot.label: HubSpot
hubspot.summary: A customer-owned private-app or OAuth token can create native HubSpot call engagements on mapped contacts.
hubspot.fallback: Use Ferocity independently or configure the signed service-platform bridge.

servicetitan.label: ServiceTitan
servicetitan.summary: The signed coexistence bridge is available; a native enterprise adapter requires approved customer and provider access.
servicetitan.fallback: Use Ferocity independently or send approved events through the signed bridge.

quickbooks.label: QuickBooks
quickbooks.summary: Portable accounting and tax exports work; live QuickBooks synchronization is not enabled.
quickbooks.fallback: Export the accounting package for QuickBooks or an accountant.

marketplacepro.label: MarketplacePro
marketplacepro.summary: Legacy exact-account inbound compatibility is present but not end-to-end certified; connection-bound v1 delivery is staged and disabled pending coordinated rollout.

capabilityEvidence.legacy_account_bound_inbound: Shared-token compatibility requires a mandatory exact account mapping and remains uncertified.
capabilityEvidence.v1_signed_owner_pilot_staged: Parallel HMAC endpoints, server enrollment, transaction revalidation, and replay inbox are local-only pending migration and sender certification.

marketplacepro.fallback: Keep outbound sync paused and reconcile only through existing audited Ferocity records.

supabase_auth.label: Authentication and workspace data
supabase_auth.summary: Authentication and tenant data foundations are live.

webhook_framework.label: Signed webhooks
webhook_framework.summary: The signed webhook framework is live for implemented event contracts.
webhook_framework.fallback: Queue and replay events from the audit log.

calendar_provider.label: Portable calendar
calendar_provider.summary: Ferocity scheduling and iCalendar export work without a third-party calendar account.

external_publishing.label: Website and content publishing
external_publishing.summary: Hosted pages and exportable publishing packages work; arbitrary CMS editing requires a supported connection mode.
external_publishing.fallback: Publish a Ferocity-hosted page or export the content package.
